attempts.summary: INC-042 resolved. Loki identified node2 as the origin at 2026-09-02T14:24:11.093328Z, where nginx rejected the unknown `upstream_timeoutx` directive. The single faulty line was removed, all three tiers and the node1 request path now return HTTP 200, and the incident report was created. Every node was rebooted individually and fully recovered with a changed boot ID.
